person_note: The Goodreads passages repeatedly show sustained close-third narration centered on Cal, while first- and second-person forms occur only in dialogue, generic formulations, or an embedded song. Independent publisher excerpts demonstrate the same third-person mode in the opening and an interior section. Author interviews, scholarly analysis, and a reputable review explicitly describe the whole novel as third person, with no evidence of sustained sections in another person. The remaining uncertainty is only the ordinary limitation that the excerpts do not reproduce every page; the whole-book structural sources resolve that limitation.
